mapper.select: SELECT j.id AS judgment_id, t.student_id, j.process_status, COALESCE((SELECT c.corrected ->> 'result' FROM judgment_correction c WHERE c.judgment_id = j.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1), j.result) AS result FROM judgment j JOIN answer a ON a.id = j.answer_id JOIN attempt t ON t.id = a.attempt_id WHERE j.id = #{judgmentId} FOR UPDATE OF j

SELECT id, judgment_id, error_report_id, reason, previous ->> 'result' AS previous, corrected ->> 'result' AS corrected, corrected_by, idempotency_key, created_at FROM judgment_correction WHERE idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM judgment_correction WHERE error_report_id = #{reportId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO judgment_correction (id, judgment_id, error_report_id, reason, previous, corrected, corrected_by, idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{judgmentId}, #{reportId}, #{reason}, jsonb_build_object('result', CAST(#{previous} AS text)), jsonb_build_object('result', CAST(#{corrected} AS text)), #{correctedBy}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt})
